lane_b_rows_with_no_url_at_all.why_no_firecrawl: Firecrawl is preferred wherever a family is already qualified, and no family can be known before its lookup returns a page. The plan therefore prices every acquisition at the SAFE DEFAULT lane; the real mix will be cheaper, and re-planning after the lookups is what makes that a measurement rather than a hope.
